themes.name: Parser / processing pipeline rewrite and Click 9.0
Terminal utilities: prompts, editor/pager, color, files and paths
Typing, public API cleanup and documentation

duplicates.reason: Both ask for '...' to be added automatically to the metavar in help output when an option has multiple=True.
Both report that confirm/prompts read from piped stdin instead of the terminal, and both ask for prompts to read from the tty.

top_issues.reason: Tracking issue for the Click 9.0 release, which removes deprecations and the hacks that many other issues depend on.
Parser rewrite started by the maintainer but not finished; it is the root fix for many long-standing parsing bugs (473, 590, 680, 742, 1269, 1279, 1322, 1574).
Confirmed bug with clear reproduction steps: completing --opt=value in bash and zsh is broken, and zsh deletes the option text.
New unlabelled report: click.edit fails on Windows about half the time. Needs a decision on whether this is a Windows platform bug or something to work around in Click.
Long-standing bug: chained commands that take both an argument and an option fail with 'No such command'.

records.judge_reason: Help output and Shell completion closely match the labelled groupings. The terminal utilities theme is coherent, though it absorbs the file and path type issues (#2645, #2429, #1378, #3888, #1428), which the labels place under parameters and types. The second theme is a catch-all: it merges the parser rewrite, Click 9.0 release items, parameter-parsing issues, command and context bugs (#473, #1269, #1322, #680, #1574, #2753, #2801, #2402), error-handling issues (#531, #2853) and #2992, a help-output issue. In doing so it absorbs most of the labelled 'Commands, context and embedding' theme. Async and embedding was split off as a small theme of its own. The typing and API cleanup theme is broadly reasonable but includes #3036, which belongs with parameter types. Overall several themes match, but one large theme mixes unrelated issues.
